Table 3: VQA accuracy (%) comparison across DocHaystack, InfoHaystack, and Proposed Invoice Haystack benchmarks. Zero-shot results use full document context; entries marked “–” reflect context-window limitations. For V-RAG and VL-RAG, the best accuracy across Top-1/3/5 is reported. Best result per column is in bold.

Fig. 4: Proposed VL-RAG architecture. The approach operates via two parallel streams. The Vision Stream (top) employs SigLIP and OpenCLIP to capture layout and structural features, while the Text Stream (bottom) uses OCR followed by BGELarge to encode semantic content. Similarity scores for all three encoders are averaged (SimAvg) to rank the corpus, and the top-m candidates undergo VLM-based binary verification to produce the final top-k output.
